messages:
AJ: Quick sync — ZephyrHealth pilot kickoff next Wed (pref). Need to finalize POC scope + success criteria by EOD Tue. Can we lock: 1) three user journeys, 2) prompt + eval set, 3) infra/pricing ask, 4) security questionnaire owner?

Maria: I can shepherd use-case prioritization. Proposed journeys: a) claims summarization (extract & redact PHI), b) policy Q&A for agents, c) agent-assist snippets (autocomplete & suggested responses). Thoughts?

Devon: Claims summarization ok. For redaction we need Private or VPC — otherwise we can't process PHI on hosted. That is a blocker. @AJ is Zephyr ok with Private deployment?

Priya: Customer prefers VPC. They asked about timeline: 4-week pilot, MVP endpoints only. Also sent updated security questionnaire: https://zephyr.internal/secure/zeph-sq.pdf

Casey (security): I skimmed the SQ — mostly standard but need clarifications on KMS/HSM, retention windows, and access review cadence. I'll own responses. Need a contact at Zephyr for legal & infra (SOC/IDS).

AJ: @Priya to confirm legal contact. Pricing question from them: committed capacity vs pay-as-you-go. My proposal: 1-month free trial, then a 3-month dedicated trial at a discounted reserved rate to cover infra setup. @Devon any ops constraints on that?

Devon: Ops: we can provision a dedicated GPU pool for a 3-month trial but need expected QPS, peak concurrency, and model choice. Recommend quantized 7B or redwood-compat 13B depending on latency need. Send payload sizes and sample prompts and we can estimate cost.

Maria: For success criteria, propose short measurable targets:
- Functional: >=90% accuracy on 100 eval prompts for summarization (including PII redaction precision)
- Latency: p95 < 350ms for agent-assist (small payloads)
- Integration: two endpoints running in staging + automated eval harness
- Ops: no incident-level security flags during pilot
- Business: 3 live agents using assist flows for at least 1 week

AJ: Can we get a short prompt + eval sample by EOD tomorrow? Example prompt:
```
User: "Summarize claim #123, remove any patient identifiers and redact policy numbers."
Expected: "Summary: ... (no PHI)"
```

Priya: I'll pull 30 anonymized claims from their test dataset and share with Casey for compliance review. Will confirm legal contact.

Casey (security): Ensure the scrub process is documented. I need a scrub-script snippet (regex rules + masking examples) before any data transfer.

Maria: Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Priya: customer legal contact + anonymized bundle (Due: Tue noon)
- Devon: infra options & cost estimate for 1-month free vs 3-month reserved (Due: Tue EOD)
- Casey: complete SQ answers & scrub checklist (Due: Tue EOD)
- AJ: pricing proposal + SOW draft (Due: Tue EOD)

AJ: I'll assemble a single kickoff deck with these items. :thumbsup:

eva-bot: Deployment reservation created: draft-pilot-zephyr (ticket #12345)

Priya: Quick Q — if they require HSM-backed KMS, what's the delta on time/cost?

Devon: HSM/KMS adds lead time (~2–3 weeks) for provisioning and contract wrangling, plus infra cost bump for HSM-backed keys. Mark HSM as stretch for pilot; recommend waiver for initial trial.

AJ: Noted — we'll flag HSM as a potential timeline risk in the kickoff. End of thread.
